subject: P2-H + P2-I corrected — two falsified assumptions in G9 trust-contract plan
contract_rationale: Inline trace and module data as <script type='application/json'> blocks in index.html. Dashboard JS reads from DOM (document.getElementById), no fetch(), no window.__MCP_* globals. test-path == user-path. Honoring line-4 file:// promise structurally, not behaviorally. Simpler than local-HTTP alternative; no server to spin up for PO or user.
assertion_5_rationale: All 9 real scenario traces are status=pass (ground truth verified). Permanent red fixture taints P2-I sign-off. Resolution: renderCard() pure unit assertion in trust-contract.spec.js — construct synthetic fail trace IN-MEMORY, call renderCard(), assert returned HTML contains mcp-dot-fail. No on-disk fixture required. Real RED→GREEN proof deferred to G10/P2-J-K where a genuine bug injection produces a genuine red card.

falsified_assumption_1.evidence: dashboard fetchTrace() checks window.__MCP_TRACES__ FIRST (index.html line ~352), loadModules() checks window.__MCP_MODULES__ FIRST (line ~454). When user double-clicks index.html: no globals injected, Chromium blocks file:// fetch() ('URL scheme file is not supported'), primitives panel shows 'No traces found', modules panel shows 'Failed to load modules.json'. Two of three panels empty for real user.
falsified_assumption_1.internal_contradiction: index.html line 4 claims 'zero network dependency'; lines 332-333 note Firefox blocks file:// fetch and recommends python3 -m http.server. P2-I instructed file:// with 'no server needed' while data loading silently required either globals or a server.

falsified_assumption_2.evidence: jq '.status' on all 9 real dashboard/traces/*.json = 'pass' for every file including failure-named scenarios. sparkline-regression-tripwire.json has status=fail with error='Regression tripwire: mismatch on expected output (intentional RED indicator for trust-contract G9 P2-H)'. This fixture renders a permanent red card. P2-I asks user 'do all tools work correctly?' — user sees a red card. Direct contradiction.
falsified_assumption_2.correct_scope: Real RED→GREEN visual proof belongs at G10/P2-J-K: genuine bug injection → genuine red card → dev fix → green. That is where the honest RED demonstration occurs.
